name: Blend
description: Built-in ABI for the Blend lending protocol, auto-seeded on indexer startup so supply/borrow events decode out of the box.

functions.name: supply
functions.description: Supply an asset to the lending pool as collateral.

functions.name: withdraw
functions.description: Withdraw previously supplied collateral from the lending pool.

functions.name: borrow
functions.description: Borrow an asset against supplied collateral.
